description: This file provides functions and types for handling archive extraction, including support for zip and tar formats, with features like size limits, path validation, and safe extraction procedures.

methods.name: resolveArchiveKind
methods.description: Determines whether a file path corresponds to a zip or tar archive based on its extension.

methods.name: resolvePackedRootDir
methods.description: Resolves the root directory of a packed archive, considering markers and directory structure.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Wraps a promise with a timeout, rejecting if the timeout is exceeded.

methods.name: extractArchive
methods.description: Extracts an archive (zip or tar) to a destination directory with size limits and timeout.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: readJsonFile
methods.description: Reads a JSON file and parses its contents.
